title: Old Point Loma Lighthouse
scope: Standing Old Point Loma Lighthouse at Cabrillo National Monument, with its whitewashed dwelling, west kitchen lean-to, central tower, circular gallery, copper lantern cap, east-side entrance steps and reconstructed assistant keeper’s cottage.
limitations: The named present footprint is used for current wall extents. The register’s earlier 20 by 30 foot description refers to the original residence. HABS records the measured form that is visible today.
The keeper’s cottage is the present reconstruction. Its eaves, sash pattern and roof details are estimated within the separate native footprint.
The preserved lantern is represented as unlit. Lens and tower access details are simplified. Landscaping and temporary signage are outside the built scope.
